def native_storage_fixture(end=False):
    geometry, _, _ = fake_family()
    shared = {tag for tag, p in geometry.items() if p[0] == 1.}
    columns = (*a.DISP, 'temperature', *a.FORCE) if end else (*a.DISP, 'temperature')
    fields = ('id', 'x', 'y', 'z', *columns)
    saved = []
    for tag, p in geometry.items():
        row = [str(tag), *(format(x, '.17g') for x in p), *('0.0' if k != 'temperature' else '400.0' for k in columns)]
        saved.append(row)
        if tag in shared: saved.append(list(row))
    return geometry, shared, columns, fields, saved


class NativeDoubletStorageGuards(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_complete_native425_IDs_shared25_doublets_and_prebirth_singletons(self):
        geometry, shared, columns, fields, saved = native_storage_fixture()
        self.assertEqual(len(shared), 25); self.assertEqual(len(saved), 450)
        with TemporaryDirectory() as name:
            path = Path(name) / 'thermoelastic_begin_0080.csv'
            path.write_text('\n'.join([','.join(fields), *(','.join(row) for row in saved)]) + '\n')
            values, storage = a.node_sample(path, geometry, set(geometry), columns, shared)
            self.assertEqual(set(values), set(geometry)); self.assertEqual(storage['raw_row_count'], 450)
            self.assertEqual(storage['unique_source_ID_count'], 425); self.assertEqual(storage['expected_shared_doublet_IDs'], sorted(shared))
            self.assertEqual(len(storage['verified_doublets']), 25); self.assertEqual(storage['raw_csv_sha256'], a.sha(path))
            for item in storage['verified_doublets']:
                self.assertEqual(len(item['csv_line_numbers_1_based']), 2)
                self.assertEqual(len(item['complete_field_token_sha256']), 64)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError): a.node_sample(path, geometry, set(geometry), columns)
            old = {tag for tag, p in geometry.items() if p[0] <= 1.}
            unique = [next(row for row in saved if a.integer(row[0]) == tag) for tag in sorted(old)]
            path.write_text('\n'.join([','.join(fields), *(','.join(row) for row in unique)]) + '\n')
            values, storage = a.node_sample(path, geometry, old, columns)
            self.assertEqual(len(values), 225); self.assertEqual(storage['raw_row_count'], 225); self.assertEqual(storage['verified_doublets'], [])

    def test_missing_extra_triple_nonshared_and_unequal_complete_tokens_refused(self):
        geometry, shared, columns, fields, saved = native_storage_fixture(end=True)
        first = min(shared); pair = [i for i, row in enumerate(saved) if a.integer(row[0]) == first]
        outsider = next(row for row in saved if a.integer(row[0]) not in shared)
        cases = []
        cases.append([row for i, row in enumerate(saved) if i != pair[1]])  # Missing one required second row.
        cases.append([*saved, list(outsider)])  # A nonshared extra row is never permitted.
        cases.append([*saved, list(saved[pair[0]])])  # A third identical row is never permitted.
        for field, value in [('disp_x', '-0.0'), ('rx', '-0.0'), ('id', str(first) + '.0')]:
            bad = [list(row) for row in saved]; bad[pair[1]][fields.index(field)] = value; cases.append(bad)
        bad = [list(row) for row in saved]; bad[pair[1]][fields.index('y')] = '-0.0'; cases.append(bad)
        with TemporaryDirectory() as name:
            path = Path(name) / 'thermoelastic_end_0080.csv'
            # All eleven END fields, including reaction tokens, must match exactly.
            self.assertEqual(len(fields), 11)
            path.write_text('\n'.join([','.join(fields), *(','.join(row) for row in saved)]) + '\n')
            values, storage = a.node_sample(path, geometry, set(geometry), columns, shared)
            self.assertEqual(len(values), 425); self.assertEqual(len(storage['verified_doublets']), 25)
            for bad in cases:
                path.write_text('\n'.join([','.join(fields), *(','.join(row) for row in bad)]) + '\n')
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError): a.node_sample(path, geometry, set(geometry), columns, shared)
            path.write_text('\n'.join([','.join(fields), *(','.join(row) for row in saved)]) + '\n')
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError): a.node_sample(path, geometry, set(geometry), columns, set(sorted(shared)[:-1]))

    def test_original_thermal_and_reference_callers_retain_strict_uniqueness(self):
        geometry, shared, _, _, _ = native_storage_fixture()
        for column, active in [('temperature', set(geometry)), ('born_reference_temperature', {tag for tag, p in geometry.items() if p[0] >= 1.})]:
